g.text: IN- & OUT- share common GND plane
ELECTRICAL SPECIFICATIONS & JST-XH PERFBOARD BUS MAP
• LEFT HEADER = 100% USER CONTROLS & DISPLAY: Joystick (VRX, VRY, SW), Wake, TM1637.
• RIGHT HEADER = 100% LIGHTS & AUDIO: 3x Green LEDs, NeoPixel Ring, MAX98357A I2S Amp.
• Safe Wi-Fi ADC1: VRX (D34) & VRY (D35) on ADC1 ensure 100% glitch-free dialing during Wi-Fi.
• Safe USB Programming: Plug in USB anytime without disconnecting battery; onboard diode protects USB!
🔌 PERFBOARD JST-XH POLARIZED CONNECTOR PINOUTS (GROUPED BY HEADER):
• J2 [PWR_SW] (2-Pin): Pin 1 = Switch COM, Pin 2 = Switch NO (Inline positive)
• J3 [SPEAKER] (2-Pin): Pin 1 = SPK+, Pin 2 = SPK- (From MAX98357A)
• J4 [TOP_RING] (3-Pin / Right): Pin 1 = +5V, Pin 2 = NEO_RING_DIN (GPIO 23), Pin 3 = GND
• J5 [DISPLAY] (4-Pin / Left): Pin 1 = +5V, Pin 2 = GND, Pin 3 = DISP_DIO (GPIO 26), Pin 4 = DISP_CLK (GPIO 25)
• J6 [JOYSTICK] (5-Pin / Left): Pin 1 = +3V3, Pin 2 = GND, Pin 3 = VRX (GPIO 34), Pin 4 = VRY (GPIO 35), Pin 5 = SW (GPIO 32)
• J7 [FRONT_LEDS] (4-Pin / Right): Pin 1 = +5V (Anodes), Pin 2 = Q1 Drain (LED1), Pin 3 = Q2 Drain (LED2), Pin 4 = Q3 Drain (LED3)
• J8 [WAKE_BTN] (2-Pin / Left): Pin 1 = BTN_WAKE (GPIO 33), Pin 2 = GND
• F1 (1.1A PTC Polyfuse): Resets automatically on short circuit. Replaces dangerous 3.15A glass fuse.
• C1 (1000 µF 10V electrolytic): Absorbs NeoPixel inrush current and prevents audio rail ripple.
• MAX98357A GAIN: Left Floating/Open for 9dB Gain. Firmware capped at 0.84 to prevent clipping.
• 100% Clean Boot: Strapping pins D2, D12, D15, TX0, RX0 are completely untouched.
• BEFORE plugging in the ESP32 DevKit into its socket: Measure Mini360 OUT+ with multimeter and turn trimpot until it reads EXACTLY 5.00V!
2. MCU (LEFT = UI & INPUTS | RIGHT = AUDIO & LEDS)
LEFT: UI & Controls (Pins 7-12) | RIGHT: Audio & Lights (Pins 6,7,9,10,11,14,15)
